findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping on document lookup
findings.body: The diff removes `tenantId: ctx.user.tenantId` from the `where` clause of `db.documents.findFirst` inside `getDocument`. Any authenticated user can now supply a known or guessed document ID belonging to another tenant and receive that tenant's document — an IDOR that breaks tenant isolation. The preceding `if (!ctx.user) throw new UnauthorizedError()` check only proves the caller is logged in, not which tenant's data is readable, and a repo-wide search confirms `tenantId` appears nowhere else, so no compensating filter exists. Restore the `tenantId` constraint (or equivalent tenant authorization) before merging.
